description: This file defines a PHP trait DataSetRelationsTrait that provides methods for managing DataSet relationships within models, including adding, retrieving, and removing DataSet associations. It interacts with a database and assumes certain naming conventions for relationship tables and fields.

methods.name: getDataSetTable
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship table based on the model's table name.

methods.name: addDataSet
methods.description: Adds a DataSet to the current model with a specified order, inserting or replacing the relationship record in the database.

methods.name: getAllDataSet
methods.description: Retrieves all DataSet objects associated with the current model, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: removeDataSet
methods.description: Removes the association between a DataSet and the current model.
